item.title: Lawyers of Chicago woman shot by federal agents say documents show how DHS lies about investigations
item.description: Marimar Martinez was shot five times by a Border Patrol agent in October while in her vehicle.

item.title: House panel OKs lawsuits against vaccine makers over ads shown in Florida
item.description: The Florida House Civil Justice & Claims Committee approved a bill Wednesday that would let people sue vaccine manufacturers if the drugs advertised in the state harm them.

item.title: Elon Musk’s tunneling company tapped to link Universal parks
item.description: Elon Musk’s tunneling firm The Boring Company will enter negotiations to design and build infrastructure improvements between Universal’s Central Florida parks and hotels.

item.title: Member of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission ousted in dispute over antisemitism
item.description: The ousted member, Carrie Prejean Boller, had defended commentator Candace Owens.

item.title: Shorthanded Heat find way to go into break with winning record with 123-111 decision over Pelicans
item.description: A 29-27 record hardly is optimal at the All-Star break for a Miami Heat team seeking to avoid the play-in round for a fourth consecutive season. But at least it beats the .500 alternative.

item.title: Winderman’s view: Even in victory, Heat go into break as little more than an abstract
